invariants.description: Fourier conduction: Q = open_flag k_th A_f/(d_up + d_down) (T_up - T_down), Q_down = Q, Q_up = -Q (energy conserved across the face) (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(Q, open_flag*k_th*A_f/(d_up + d_down)*(T_up - T_down), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.array_equal(Q_down, Q) and np.array_equal(Q_up, -Q)

invariants.description: second law: heat flows from hot to cold, Q (T_up - T_down) >= 0
